property_summary: For any valid fallback call (msg.value == 10 ether and block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) the reference contract only drains its balance to the caller when block.number % 15 == 0, so address(c).balance remains nonzero after a qualifying call when block.number % 15 != 0; the mutant unconditionally drains the balance after updating pastBlockTime, violating this by making address(c).balance == 0 for some inputs where block.number % 15 != 0.
change_summary: Insert an unconditional transfer to sender after updating pastBlockTime so every qualifying call drains the contract.
